name: Jakim
overview: Jakim was a male member of the tribe of Benjamin, identified specifically as the son of Shimei according to 1 Chronicles 8:19. There are no additional notes or detailed accounts of his life, making his profile concise and focused on his lineage within the Benjaminite tribe.
namesAndTitles: The name Jakim means 'he will establish,' reflecting a Hebrew origin. This proper name is not indicated as being given directly by God but carries a meaning that suggests stability or foundation, as noted in 1 Chronicles 8:19.
familyAndRelationships: Jakim is explicitly recorded as the son of Shema, as stated in 1 Chronicles 8:19. Beyond this, Scripture does not provide further family relationships or descendants connected to him.
scriptureSignificance: Jakim’s significance lies primarily in his genealogical placement within the tribe of Benjamin, as documented in the genealogies of 1 Chronicles. His mention helps to preserve the lineage and tribal identity important for understanding Israel’s history and the fulfillment of God’s promises to the patriarchs.
